title: 機械力学
subtitle: Dynamics of  Machines
teachers:
FUJITA Koji
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
Dynamics of Machines is a part of the subject mechanics which is the basis of mechanical engineering.
Students will learn the motions of mass points and rigid bodies due to external force or torque.
advice:
Students will learn the meanings of mathematical formulas and gain understanding by solving exercises.
We will cover the following materials:
1. Momentum, impulse, law of conservation of momentum, and collision
2. Work and energy
3. Law of conservation of mechanical energy
4. Loss of kinetic energy by collision
5. Power
6. Friction
books: Same as "Engineering Mechanics I", and "Engineering Mechanics II."
requiredKnowledge:
Acquisition of Engineering mechanics I and II
Sufficient skill in mathematics

              Dynamics of Machines is a part of the subject mechanics which is the basis of mechanical engineering.
Students will learn the motions of mass points and rigid bodies due to external force or torque.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              Students will learn the meanings of mathematical formulas and gain understanding by solving exercises.
We will cover the following materials:
1. Momentum, impulse, law of conservation of momentum, and collision
2. Work and energy
3. Law of conservation of mechanical energy
4. Loss of kinetic energy by collision
5. Power
6. Friction
